lyrics:
[Intro: bright steel-pan synth, disco hi-hats, bass slide]

[Verse 1: sunny, wistful female voice]
They put a candle in a lime
The whole deck sang it out of time
I thought I'd mind it more than this
A paper crown, a chlorine kiss

[Chorus: soft disco groove, group harmonies]
Fifty feels like this
Bare feet on warm bricks
Nobody left to impress
Fifty feels like this
A little slower, nothing missed
Oh, fifty feels like this

[Verse 2: voice brighter, guitar chiming]
At twenty I was in a rush
At thirty-five I had too much
Now I know what's worth the fuss
It's this, and about six of us

[Chorus: soft disco groove, group harmonies]
Fifty feels like this
Bare feet on warm bricks
Nobody left to impress
Fifty feels like this
A little slower, nothing missed
Oh, fifty feels like this

[Bridge: half-time, steel pans, friends calling out]
Make a wish (I've got it)
Make a wish (I've got it already)

[Outro: steel pans, glasses clinking, the friends singing]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 112 BPM, 4/4, C major. Sunny, easy and quietly proud.

VOICE: Female, bright and wistful with a smile in it, relaxed and conversational. A small group of friends sings the chorus harmonies and calls out in the bridge.

INSTRUMENTS: A bright steel-pan-like synth, a soft disco drum kit with open hi-hats, a sliding, melodic bass guitar, a chiming clean guitar, warm pads, shaker, clinking glasses.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, steel pans. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:46 Chorus 1. 1:18 Verse 2. 1:50 Chorus 2. 2:22 Bridge, half-time. 2:44 Outro, friends singing, ends 3:18.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2010s Californian electronic pop: bright, breezy and clean, voice warm in front, steel pans sparkling on top.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'It's this, and about six of us' at 1:44.

STATION FIT: Saturday, 6:30 p.m. A sunny vocal track for the first drink of the evening.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Wary, amused, sure, celebrating.
